chandavāsinī.p: [Chandavāsī+inī] (thī) CL=10 A woman who lives by will - as she likes. A wife who goes and lives in a man's house with similar desire. See - chandavāsī.
a: ဆန္ဒဝါသိနီ(ထီ)
